4871-6074-7824.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

104-4268-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4268-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-6458-6996.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3197-6458-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4559-4659-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-4659-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1453-2387-3490-7297.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-7297.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

252-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1762-4871-5173-5626-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2060-2292-2577-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2292-2577-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3769-4050-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3769-4050-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

5149-5200-5840.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
5149-5200-5840.notablePrerequisites:
Nantuko Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Nantuko Elder
5149-5200-5840.description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.
5149-5200-5840.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-3698-5263.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve both Grinding Station abilities from steps 1 and 4, causing target player to mill six cards.
Repeat.

3197-5783-5785.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token that has flying due to Combine Chrysalis.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

4798-5437-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4798-5437-5631-5686.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

788-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Manta Ray.
A player controls no Islands.
788-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Manta Ray to an opponent who controls no Islands.
When Manta Ray's controller controls no Islands, Manta Ray triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Manta Ray cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Manta Ray triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

1810-1953-2743.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U} if Cackling Counterpart is in hand, or {5}{U}{U} if it's in your graveyard
1810-1953-2743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional token.
1810-1953-2743.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart either from your hand by paying {1}{U}{U} or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {5}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Biovisionary token.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

1395-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

413-1548-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
413-1548-4897.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
Port Razer enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer, triggering its ability, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Port Razer, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

813-1181-4454.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Bond of Revival by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Bond of Revival from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

551-1528-2539.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting attached to any creature you control without summoning sickness.
You control an additional permanent that can tap to produce {R}.
551-1528-2539.description:
Cast Hidden Strings with any targets.
Pay {R} and tap the creature enchanted with Dual Casting to copy Hidden Strings, targeting the creature enchanted with Dual Casting and a permanent that can tap for {R}.
Twinning Staff triggers, creating a copy of Hidden Strings.
The copy targets at least the permanent.
Allow the first copy of Hidden Strings to resolve.
Tap the permanent for {R}.
Repeat steps 2-6.

250-779-3759.description:
Activate Oona's Prowler by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Oona's Prowler ability, giving it -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

321-877-2475-4648.description:
Cast Hibernation Sliver by paying {0} due to Morophon.
Hibernation Sliver enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 1 life.
Essence Sliver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hibernation Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
